scientific_integrity: General proof given; finite independent computations are corroborative. Publication priority and independent proof validation are not certified.
scientific_limitations: Finite simple undirected graphs only; complementary edge-vertex incidence; counting selected contranominal subcontexts, not embedded Boolean suborders or sublattices. Prior general contranominal criterion credited; a graph-specific earlier equivalent formulation remains possible. Verification code tests finite instances and is not an all-parameter proof.
title: Graph domination and the complete contranominal-scale spectrum of complementary incidence lattices
